name: Flowmoro
oneliner: A minimalist Pomodoro timer for focused work.
summary: Flowmoro is a Pomodoro focus timer for iPhone and Android. It keeps the screen quiet, lets you set your own work and break lengths, and collects no data.
description: Flowmoro is a focus timer built around the Pomodoro Technique: work in short, timed sessions and take regular breaks so you stay sharp through the day without burning out.

The interface is deliberately uncluttered. You see the time left, a simple fill that drains as the session runs, and one button. Work length, break length, and the number of cycles are all adjustable, and a set of theme colors plus a dark mode let it match your setup.
Flowmoro does not collect or share any data. There is no account and no sign-in.

features.title: Custom sessions
features.body: Set work and break lengths and the number of cycles to fit how you work.

features.title: Nothing in the way
features.body: One timer, one button. No feeds, no streaks, no clutter.

features.title: Themes and dark mode
features.body: Pick a theme color and switch to a clean dark mode for late sessions.

features.title: Private by design
features.body: No account, no tracking. Flowmoro does not collect or share data.

faq.a: Flowmoro is a minimalist Pomodoro timer app for iPhone and Android made by Modrn Magic. It alternates timed work sessions with breaks to help you focus.
On the App Store in the US, Flowmoro is a one-time $0.99 purchase. It is also on Google Play.
No. Flowmoro has no account system and does not collect or share personal data.
